LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.1 PUBLIC SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking, part of Strand 8 in Grade 5 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: What do we consider when speaking in public? 2. Why is it important to speak clearly and audibly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. speak clearly and audibly on a topic to express personal opinions effectively,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. apply audience awareness skills in public speaking,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate public speaking skills for self- expression.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. speak clearly and audibly on a topic to express personal opinions effectively,

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. apply audience awareness skills in public speaking,

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate public speaking skills for self- expression.

   Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch public speeches and presentations from eloquent orators in the society from audio visual sources,

2. work with peers to discuss audience awareness skills for public presentations,

3. team up with peers to organise ideas on a topic related to the theme,

4. make a presentation on the topic clearly, audibly and using appropriate audience awareness skills,

5. record themselves performing the speeches and share in class,

6. take part in a public speaking session on a topic of choice. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch public speeches and presentations from eloquent orators in the society from audio visual sources,
2. work with peers to discuss audience awareness skills for public presentations,
3. team up with peers to organise ideas on a topic related to the theme,
4. make a presentation on the topic clearly, audibly and using appropriate audience awareness skills,
5. record themselves performing the speeches and share in class,
6. take part in a public speaking session on a topic of choice. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Public Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is acquired as the learner shows concerted attention when organising ideas and making public

speeches effectively and efficiently.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner makes a presentation on the topic clearly, audibly and using

appropriate audience awareness skills.

Values:
• Unity: This is promoted as the learner collaborates with peers to organise ideas on a topic for presentation in class.

• Peace: This is cultivated as the learner displays tolerance when recording themselves performing the speeches and sharing in

class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-management and awareness: This is enhanced as the learner discovers and applies public speaking skills in their

communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the knowledge on care for digital devices to the similar concepts learnt in Science and Technology.
